items.title: Assess art discovery launch and monetization readiness
items.summary: Review arttogogh.com’s late-night art-discovery positioning, content scope, product and affiliate conversion paths, and launch health before further investment. The site is live with site, operations, cron, smoke, tasks, and social capabilities, but the supplied inventory does not show analytics or affiliate capabilities. No site-specific analytics, SEO traffic, revenue, or operations telemetry is available. Amazon attribution contains no arttogogh.com row. AI observability records 29 calls costing $5.01 from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-21, which does not establish return or avoidable spend. A committed design task to remove lines across product photos and buttons has undergone six attempts, while related improvement runs were cancelled.
items.requested_action: Approve a report-only assessment covering audience hypotheses, positioning, content and product gaps, affiliate-link and conversion presentation, measurement and attribution readiness, the repeated design-task delivery issue, validation criteria, and a prioritized backlog. Do not deploy, alter production configuration, change schedules, provision credentials, spend money, or mutate the queue.
